text:
zoe: Quick thread  we need an operational decision tree for SI-originated vs Redwood-originated pipeline and marketplace buys. last sprint there were 4 cross-team threads. want a simple deterministic flow ops can enforce.

mike: Agreed. Proposal (short): priority = 1) SI provable evidence (signed SOW, PO, or invoice) -> SI owner; 2) marketplace purchase where partner_id present on checkout -> SI owner; 3) product-originated inbound (trial sign-up, in-app demo request) -> Redwood owner; 4) simultaneous documented outreach within 12 days -> joint owner with split responsibilities.

anita: Add: if SI funds pilot (PO/SOW) they get precedence even if RW originated. require claim asserted within 10 calendar days from lead creation or forfeited. Also require at least one artifact URL for automated SI assignment.

chris: Ops reality: marketplace metadata often missing. Heuristic idea: if sku contains "p_" prefix OR order_note includes partner_handle -> flag for SI review and surface in ops queue. I'll prototype a regex rule.

ops-bot: Ticket OPS-10022 created: "marketplace partner heuristic + auto-flag" assigned to chris, due 2024-07-24.

zoe: To avoid ping-pong, include a 4-item handoff checklist in SFDC and partner portal: 1) one-paragraph deal summary, 2) named buyer POC + SI + RW POCs, 3) procurement route (marketplace/separate PO/reseller), 4) next two actions and owners. keep it copy-paste friendly.

mike: Suggest a compact intake mapping we can paste into SFDC JSON validation (use different field names to avoid collision with other drafts):
```
source_origin: [redwood|si|marketplace]
proof_url: string (required for si)
proof_type: [sow|po|invoice|email|portal_note]
claim_deadline_days: 10
owner_mode: [redwood|si|joint]
escalation_addr: partnerships@redwood.com
```

anita: Dispute flow: 2 business day initial review, if unresolved by day 3 lock to earliest documented outreach and notify both parties + buyer with an ops note explaining rationale. escalate to partnerships for reseller chains or global accounts.

chris: I'll make the ops queue show earliest outreach timestamp prominently. ops automation should add a small email template when locking ownership: "Hi <buyer>, routing update: primary owner is <entity>. Next step: <X>. Contact: <POC>." short and clear.

legal-bot: Legal reminder: locking language needs review. Submit copy to LR-601 for approval by 2024-07-15.

zoe: action items: mike -> SFDC snippet + one-pager copy, anita -> dispute playbook + locking email templates, chris -> ops heuristics + ticket. target: publish short playbook in partner portal by Friday so SEs have guidance next week.

mike: ack. will draft the one-pager and add a tiny flow graphic (Assert -> Validate -> Assign/Lock -> Notify).

anita: will draft dispute wording and include an anonymized example (remove customer names) to show how we resolved a multi-claim situation.

chris: filing OPS-10022 details now and will post the ticket link here.

ops-bot: OPS-10022: "marketplace partner heuristic + auto-flag" link: https://tracker.redwood/OPS-10022 (assigned chris).

zoe: thanks all  this should cut back-and-forth for buyers. if anyone has a counterexample where strict automation would fail, drop it here so we can add an exception rule.
